categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the pharmaceutical industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of anti-infective drugs, cardiovascular drugs, and digestive system drugs. Its main products include clarithromycin raw materials and formulations, azithromycin dispersible tablets, roxithromycin capsules, lacidipine dispersible tablets, and simvastatin tablets. The business model integrates pharmaceutical intermediates, raw materials, and finished formulations, covering both domestic and international markets.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced pharmaceutical manufacturing technologies adhering to GMP standards, with core competencies in anti-infective and antihypertensive drug production. It has developed proprietary processes for clarithromycin raw materials and formulations, and has passed consistency evaluations for key products. The production strictly follows national quality and regulatory standards, with quality control throughout the manufacturing process. The company also capitalizes certain R&D expenditures, focusing on innovative drug development and process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include pharmaceutical manufacturers and trade companies producing clarithromycin formulations domestically and internationally, with export markets in India, South Korea, Japan, Pakistan, and Turkey. The company also serves hospitals, pharmacies, and private clinics in China through bidding and agency sales models. Its products are included in national medical insurance and essential drug catalogs, ensuring stable demand in the healthcare sector.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and manufacturing facilities located in Shaoxing, Zhejiang Province. It has significant export activities targeting countries such as India, South Korea, Japan, Pakistan, and Turkey. Domestic sales cover multiple provinces, participating in national and provincial centralized procurement programs. The company is expanding its international registration and quality certifications to enhance global market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates an integrated pharmaceutical supply chain encompassing upstream pharmaceutical intermediates, midstream active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), and downstream finished drug formulations. This vertical integration enhances resource allocation efficiency, product quality control, and market competitiveness, allowing the company to manage production from raw materials to final drug products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes pharmaceutical innovation, quality management, and market expansion. R&D focuses on developing new generic drugs, improving existing products through consistency evaluations, and advancing formulations for anti-infective and cardiovascular therapies. The company invests significantly in R&D, collaborates with academic institutions, and pursues regulatory approvals domestically and internationally. Future plans include enhancing production processes, expanding product pipelines, and leveraging policy trends such as centralized procurement and medical insurance reforms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of pharmaceutical raw materials and finished drug formulations. Sales channels include direct sales to manufacturers and trade companies, exports via foreign trade companies, bidding in national and provincial centralized procurement platforms, and agency sales to pharmacies and clinics. The company also receives government subsidies related to its operations. Revenue is recognized upon delivery and acceptance of products, with pricing influenced by procurement policies and market competition.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a competitive player in the pharmaceutical manufacturing sector, particularly in anti-infective and cardiovascular drugs. It holds a leading position in clarithromycin raw material production domestically and maintains a growing international presence. Competitors include other pharmaceutical manufacturers engaged in generic drug production and API supply. The company differentiates through integrated supply chain capabilities, product quality, regulatory compliance, and inclusion in national insurance and essential drug lists.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 330 million, a slight decrease of 2.38% year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 7.8 million, down 64.01% from the previous year. The company maintains total assets near RMB 1 billion and net assets around RMB 686 million. Despite profit decline, operating cash flow improved significantly. The company invests around 5.78% of revenue in R&D, indicating a focus on sustainable growth through innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product quality, regulatory compliance, and integrated pharmaceutical supply chain advantages to deliver reliable and effective medications. It differentiates through proprietary manufacturing technologies, successful consistency evaluations, and inclusion of products in national medical insurance and essential drug catalogs, ensuring market access and reimbursement. The company also pioneers patient-centric packaging innovations, such as braille labeling and elderly-friendly instructions, reflecting commitment to social responsibility and enhanced user experience.
